claims.reasoning: Nine dollars, all of it, every penny — Jacobs is a real back on a real offense and Keenan Allen's name stopped doing anything for me weeks ago. Not leaving a dollar on the table, ever.

trade_offer.message: Coach, I'm doing you a favor here. You're sitting there 0-6 with Amon-Ra rotting on your bench like a trophy you're scared to touch — I send you two bodies, you send me the guy you're too chicken to start. Take it before I stop being nice about it.

forum_post: Kris, baby, print this: I called Rodgers before rinna's fifty-five ever landed and I don't need him anyway — I bought the whole quarterback aisle in September, Mahomes, Ward, Burrow, three names I like saying and you only need one arm at a time, sweetheart. Coach Taylor — zero and six, sixty-eight dollars just sitting there collecting dust like the rest of that trophy case — clear eyes, full hearts, empty case, Coach. I sent you a trade that's basically charity. Take the deal. Everybody else, I'm still the storyline and I'm not done writing it.
